user.title: Set up Lutron Connect Bridge
user.description: Enter the IP address or hostname of your Lutron Connect Bridge.

link.title: Press the button on your Lutron Connect Bridge
link.description:
Press the small black button on the back of the Connect Bridge at **{host}** to complete pairing, then click Submit.

If the bridge was already paired, click Submit to reconnect.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the bridge. Check the IP address and try again.

abort.not_lutron_device: Discovered device is not a Lutron device.
